''See also: [[Grandmaster Endross Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Grandmaster [[Endross]] is a volatile and unpredictable figure who holds a position of leadership. He has expressed a personal desire to forcibly remove the Valinhall Travelers{{!}}Valinhall Traveler and appears to harbor a deep, individual vendetta against [[Simon]], driven by an intense longing for the man's death. In combat, he is a formidable opponent capable of wielding two swords and manipulating elemental forces, such as a small thunderstorm. Despite being wounded and dazed in previous encounters, he has demonstrated the ability to deflect weapons and use a Gate to intercept rampaging [[Incarnations]]. His temperament is characterized by aggression and a casual attitude toward extreme violence, such as suggesting the mass killing of others.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Endross]] is a young, lithe man with dark skin and muscular build. He possesses dark eyes and is often seen resting his hands upon the hilts of his two swords.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Driven by an obsession with combat strength, this Grandmaster replaced a predecessor. He is a figure who emerged from the Gate.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|A Grandmaster who utilizes a Gate, [[Endross]] wields two swords in battle. He is capable of wreathed his left hand in a rolling, swirling thunderstorm.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|A young, dark, and strong individual, Grandmaster [[Endross]] replaced a predecessor to claim his current position. This lithe, muscled man with dark eyes emerged from a Gate, where he demonstrated the ability to wreathe his left hand in a rolling thunderstorm. While resting his hands on the hilts of his swords, he maintains an obsession with combat strength. He ultimately wields two swords alongside a swirling thunderstorm.}}
